title: Child Rights, Feelings & Personal Safety Learning (Child Track)
description: SS-CHD-009 to SS-CHD-011: Developmentally appropriate child learning track covering personal rights, body safety, safe vs. unsafe secrets, naming big feelings, identifying trusted adults, asking for help, and preparing for family visits.
outcomes: Help children recognise their personal rights, body boundaries, and the difference between safe surprises and unsafe secrets
Build age-appropriate skills for noticing body signals, naming big feelings, and using calming tools
Empower children to identify safe adults, ask for help without fear, and prepare for family contact visits
